tools.description: Show files to the user.
tools.name: send_attachments
tools.title: Send attachments

tools.description: Open a file in MaxHQ's file viewer for the user.
tools.name: open_file
tools.title: Open a file

tools.description: Show the user a web page you made, such as a chart, diagram or mockup.
tools.name: show_visual
tools.title: Show a visual

tools.description: Read the conversation of another MaxHQ agent: one list_agents names, by its id, with `device` for one on another device, or one the user attached to one of your messages as an [Agent: title] entry, by the id or the title that entry gives.
tools.name: read_agent
tools.title: Read an agent

tools.description: Lists what you may start agents with and where: the devices, vendors, accounts, workspaces and models you're allowed, how many levels of agents you may still start, and any limits on you.
tools.name: list_targets
tools.title: List where agents can start

tools.description: Lists the MaxHQ agents on this device, or on `device`, newest activity first, one line each: id, title, vendor, device, state, context used and the last reply.
tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List agents

tools.description: Starts a new MaxHQ agent with a task and returns its id.
tools.name: start_agent
tools.title: Start an agent

tools.description: Sends a message to a MaxHQ agent.
tools.name: send_agent
tools.title: Message an agent

tools.description: Waits until each of the agents you name finishes its turn, needs input or stops, up to `timeout_seconds`, 600 by default and 3600 at most.
tools.name: wait_agent
tools.title: Wait for agents

tools.description: Stops a MaxHQ agent's turn.
tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.title: Stop an agent

tools.description: Moves a MaxHQ agent to another device, once the user approves it in MaxHQ.
tools.name: move_agent
tools.title: Move an agent to another device

tools.description: Makes a scheduled task, which runs a prompt with nobody watching: on a timer, when a webhook gets a request or when a GitHub repository has new events.
tools.name: schedule_task
tools.title: Schedule a task

tools.description: Lists the scheduled tasks on the devices you're allowed, with each one's id, schedule, next run and last run.
tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List scheduled tasks

tools.description: Deletes a scheduled task by its id.
tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete a scheduled task

tools.description: Runs a scheduled task now, whatever its schedule, once the user approved it and it's on.
tools.name: run_task_now
tools.title: Run a scheduled task now

tools.description: Links a pull request in your repository to you by its number, so the user sees it with you.
tools.name: link_pull_request
tools.title: Link a pull request

tools.description: Unlinks a pull request from you by its number.
tools.name: unlink_pull_request
tools.title: Unlink a pull request

tools.description: Lists the pull requests linked to you, with each one's state and checks.
tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.title: List your pull requests

tools.description: MaxHQ wakes you when checks fail, every check passes, new comments or reviews arrive, or the PR conflicts.
tools.name: watch_pull_request
tools.title: Watch a pull request

tools.description: Stops waking you for a pull request.
tools.name: unwatch_pull_request
tools.title: Stop watching a pull request

tools.description: Lists the test machines this device hosts: iOS Simulators, Android emulators, Linux containers and macOS VMs, with whether each is ready, what it lacks, and how many wait for it.
tools.name: list_test_hosts
tools.title: List test hosts

tools.description: Leases a test machine of one kind on this device for you alone, waiting in line while it's busy.
tools.name: lease_open
tools.title: Lease a test machine

tools.description: Runs one command on a leased machine and answers its exit code and output.
tools.name: lease_run
tools.title: Run a command on a leased machine

tools.description: Takes a PNG of a leased machine's screen, scaled to at most 1280 pixels on its long edge, and shows it to you.
tools.name: lease_screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot a leased machine

tools.description: Installs an app on a leased machine from your working folder: a .app folder or .ipa for a Simulator, an .apk for an emulator, or any file or folder for a Linux container, up to 4 GiB.
tools.name: lease_install
tools.title: Install an app on a leased machine

tools.description: Ends one of your leases and frees the machine for the next caller.
tools.name: lease_close
tools.title: End a lease

tools.description: Lists your project's notes: each one's id, title and size, and when and by whom it last changed.
tools.name: list_notes
tools.title: List notes

tools.description: Reads one of your project's notes in Markdown.
tools.name: read_note
tools.title: Read a note

tools.description: Makes a note in your project with a title and a Markdown body, and gives its id.
tools.name: create_note
tools.title: Create a note

tools.description: Changes one of your project's notes: replaces `old_string` with `new_string` in its body.
tools.name: edit_note
tools.title: Edit a note

tools.description: Lists the open pull requests in a project's GitHub repository: each one's number, title, author's login, whether it's a draft, when it last changed and its link, then each author once.
tools.name: list_repo_pull_requests
tools.title: List a project's pull requests

tools.description: Shows the user a plan under the bar, with one line for each item.
tools.name: submit_plan
tools.title: Submit a plan

tools.description: Changes an agent, by the id list_agents gives: rename it, snooze it for some minutes, wake, settle or unsettle it, mark it read, set its permission mode, model or effort, or stop or delete it.
tools.name: manage_agent
tools.title: Manage an agent

tools.description: Hides a project from the sidebar or shows it, or changes its settings on a device: whether its agents resume after a restart, whether an agent settles once its PR merges, its auto-settle days, and the ports it doesn't offer to forward.
tools.name: manage_project
tools.title: Manage a project

tools.description: Starts or stops a container workspace.
tools.name: manage_workspace
tools.title: Manage a workspace

tools.description: Turns a scheduled task on or off.
tools.name: manage_task
tools.title: Manage a scheduled task

tools.description: Changes a device's settings, as Settings shows them, or updates its agent CLIs on the device and in its workspaces.
tools.name: manage_device
tools.title: Manage a device

tools.description: Lets an agent start, message and stop other agents on its own device, or takes that back.
tools.name: manage_permission
tools.title: Manage what an agent may run

tools.description: Searches MaxHQ's guide, the manual for this version, for how to do something or where something is.
tools.name: search_guide
tools.title: Search the guide

tools.description: Reads one section of MaxHQ's guide, by the id search_guide gives: its whole text and the links that open its views in the app.
tools.name: read_guide
tools.title: Read a guide section
